'''Dutana Leara''' was [[Dutan Lee]]'s younger sister, a member of the [[Dutan nest]], and a [[Salt/Legends|salt]] addict. Due to talking freely while under the influence of salt, Leara managed to sabotage several of the Dutan nest's arms deals and was responsible for missing funds.<ref name="AJ9" />
